slices.focus: An unplanned washing-machine replacement and winter supplies for grandparents expose how thin Ayaka's savings cushion has become, forcing an honest budget reset.
slices.summary: Multiple practical expenses (washing machine replacement, winter supplies for grandparents) hit simultaneously, revealing Ayaka's savings buffer is much thinner than she believed. She designs a budget with a monthly cap on convenience spending, a separate home-maintenance reserve, and family support treated as a protected flexible-range category. She commits to a three-month recovery pace rather than aggressive austerity.
open_loops: Three-month recovery plan could be derailed by another large unexpected expense
Family support as a flexible-range category may still squeeze other spending
One broken appliance felt catastrophic — next one may too
